claim: On November 7, 2022 ElastiCache for Redis OSS gained IPv6 support: you can configure a cluster to accept only IPv4 connections, only IPv6 connections, or both (dual-stack). IPv6 is supported for Redis OSS engine version 6.2 onward on all instances built on the Nitro system, with no additional charges.
question: When did ElastiCache add IPv6 and dual-stack clusters for Redis OSS, and which versions support it?

values.spoken: Redis OSS six point two onward

qualifiers.scope: ElastiCache for Redis OSS clusters on Nitro instances
